title: Base ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines common ship properties shared by all ship types. Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

mass.description: Ship mass in kilograms. Required per ADR-0009 (every rigid body MUST have mass) and ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

inertia_scale.description: Dimensionless multiplier on the default spherical inertia tensor. 1.0 = sphere with radius 1m. Higher values simulate mass concentrated farther from center.

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box of the mesh in ship-local coordinates (metres). Computed once from glTF mesh. Used for camera position defaults, debug axes, and spatial calculations. Min and max are opposite corners of the box.

min.description: Minimum corner (x, y, z in metres).

max.description: Maximum corner (x, y, z in metres).

propulsion.description: Propulsion system configuration. Defines main thrusters (forward/backward) and maneuvering thrusters (rotation + strafe). Required per ADR-0014 (gameplay values in JSON).

main_thrusters.description: Array of main thruster configurations. For M2, exactly one thruster is active. In M3+, the player can switch between thrusters (e.g. cruise vs. combat mode).

maneuvering_thruster.description: Maneuver thruster (RCS) configuration for rotation and lateral/vertical strafe.

collision_shape.description: Collision shape for the ship. Defines how it interacts with other objects. Derived from bounding_box per ADR-0044.

type.description: Collision shape type. 'sphere' or 'box' are supported for M3.

radius.description: Radius of the sphere in metres (for sphere shape type).

half_extents.description: Half-extents of the box (for box shape type).

physical_quantity_mass.description: Physical quantity with mass unit (kg). Per ADR-0008. See units.schema.json for the central unit registry.

value.description: Mass value. Must be positive and finite.

unit.description: Unit of mass. Must be 'kg' (see units.schema.json).

physical_quantity_force.description: Physical quantity with force unit (Newtons). Per ADR-0008. See units.schema.json for the central unit registry.

value.description: Force value. Must be non-negative and finite.

unit.description: Unit of force. Must be 'N' (see units.schema.json).

physical_quantity_torque.description: Physical quantity with torque unit (Newton-meters). Per ADR-0008. See units.schema.json for the central unit registry.

value.description: Torque value. Must be non-negative and finite.

unit.description: Unit of torque. Must be 'N⋅m' (see units.schema.json).

main_thruster.description: A main thruster configuration. Produces forward and backward linear force along the ship's longitudinal axis (-Z forward per ADR-0006).

id.description: Unique identifier for this thruster within the ship. Used to select the active thruster in M3+.

type.description: Thruster type. Determines fuel consumption, heat, sound, and VFX in M3+. For M2, this is metadata only.

max_forward_thrust.description: Maximum forward thrust in Newtons (applied along -Z local axis).

max_backward_thrust.description: Maximum backward/reverse thrust in Newtons (applied along +Z local axis). Typically lower than forward thrust.

maneuvering_thruster.description: Maneuver thruster (RCS) configuration. Produces torque for rotation (pitch, yaw, roll) and force for lateral/vertical strafe.

type.description: Maneuvering thruster type. Determines response characteristics in M3+. For M2, this is metadata only.

max_torque.description: Maximum torque in Newton-meters applied around each rotation axis (pitch=X, yaw=Y, roll=Z per ADR-0006).

max_strafe_thrust.description: Maximum strafe thrust in Newtons applied along each lateral/vertical axis (left/right=X, up/down=Y). Same value for all strafe directions.

physical_quantity_length.description: Physical quantity with length unit (m). Per ADR-0008. See units.schema.json for the central unit registry.

value.description: Length value. Must be positive and finite.

unit.description: Unit of length. Must be 'm' (see units.schema.json).
